extractedWith: tools/extract/extract.ps1 -Batch p6-be-att-infra -Manifest <scratch copy of allowlist.manifest.yaml plus the p6-be-att-infra batch> -Clean (staging %TEMP%/codelab-extract/p6-be-att-infra, outside the repo; scrub and secret findings are expected before the rewrite)
promotion: Each staged file was read as a reference and rewritten with starter names and structure; "target" is the repo file it informed, "stagedTarget" the path in the staging folder. Content is a rewrite, so the repo file hash differs from stagedSha256. The JWT service token, the shared receipt secret, the relayed upload, the base64 download envelope and the source-product module/folder ids were left behind.

origins.note: Pattern only: an offline check of the attachment service receipt (no network call on link). The JWT-shaped receipt, the shared UTF-8 secret, the kill switch and the module/folder/file claims were left behind; the starter verifies the r1. token with Codelab.Security UploadReceiptSigner under the Codelab:Security:Uploads key ring, returns null when receipts are disabled, and takes the MIME type from UploadContentTypes.

Pattern only: the typed HttpClient adapter, the transport-failure wrapping and the caller-cancellation versus timeout test. The bearer service token, the relayed upload, the listing and the base64 download envelope were left behind; the starter calls GET/DELETE /api/files/{fileId} with the ES256 service assertion, maps 404 to not found and every other failure to AttachmentStorageUnavailableException (503).
Pattern only (tampered, wrong key, malformed and disabled cases); keys are generated at run time, the fixture secrets were not carried.
Pattern only: a stub HttpMessageHandler drives the status mapping, connection failure, timeout and caller cancellation; the token and envelope cases were not carried.

Pattern only: the Restrict foreign key to the type and the filtered unique file index. The link is generic (record type + record id, no foreign key into another module), the file id is unique outright, and removal is a soft RemovedAt.
Pattern only: the type catalog mapping. Fixed ids (never generated), a unique key and the stored extension list are the starter shape; source-product columns were left behind.

Pattern only: no-tracking reads of the type catalog and of live attachments per record. Folder/module lookups, retention queries and request-specific joins were left behind; the store implements the module port IAttachmentStore over AttachmentsDbContext.

Not carried in phase 6: removed files are deleted through the outbox (attachments.delete-file, DeleteAttachmentFileHandler); a sweep of uploads that were never linked needs a service listing endpoint the phase 6 contract does not have. Documented as a Gotcha in the module MODULE.md; candidate for a later phase.
